page_title: EIN 3-1 AUG | Eintracht Frankfurt v Augsburg 19/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

90+5' 3 - 1 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces an outstanding solo effort and takes the responsibility to shoot. The ball goes low into the middle of the net and past the helpless goalkeeper.
90+5' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' Sven Michel (Augsburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.
90+4' Arne Maier (Augsburg) launches a cross from the corner, but Kevin Trapp is alert to thwart the effort.
90+4' Sven Michel (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Augsburg are going to take it.
90+3' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
89' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Mario Gotze and he is replaced by Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt).
89' Substitution. Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Buta.
86' Martin Petersen blows for a foul after Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
86' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
85' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Arne Maier (Augsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Augsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
81' Sven Michel (Augsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kristijan Jakic departs the field of play to be replaced by Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg).
80' The referee signals a substitution. Sven Michel (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Arne Engels.
78' Here is a change. Hugo Ekitike is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
78' Substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe walks off the pitch and Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
76' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
76' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

75' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
74' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
72' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:4.
70' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Philipp Max.

68' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Finn Dahmen pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
67' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) duly receives a yellow card.
65' Substitution. Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Phillip Tietz walks off.
65' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.

64' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen keeps it out.

61' 2 - 1 Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes off the post into the bottom left corner and the score changes to 2:1.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pep Biel (Augsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Ruben Vargas cannot continue after picking up an injury.
55' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Junior Dina Ebimbe laid the ball off to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
53' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

53' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
52' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

51' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arne Engels (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
40' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
38' The ratio of the ball possession is 63:37.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.
36' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
34' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
28' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar.
28' Arne Engels (Augsburg) will deliver the corner kick.
27' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.
26' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
25' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.

24' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Finn Dahmen!
22' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.

20' What a chance that is! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!
15' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Finn Dahmen sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic provides Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 0:1.
11' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
9' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

6' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
3' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Martin Petersen.
